workstream: PR-01 through PR-05 disposable integration composition

DELETE /v1/me/collections/:collectionId.purpose: Soft-delete an authenticated actor-owned collection without deleting source posts or Saved rows.
DELETE /v1/me/collections/:collectionId.authentication: Bearer session with saved:manage capability required.
DELETE /v1/me/collections/:collectionId.authorization: Only the owner may delete; cross-user IDs return NOT_FOUND.

request.validation: Unknown query fields and stale revisions are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data {deleted:true}.

DELETE /v1/me/collections/:collectionId.idempotencyConcurrency: Soft delete is version-guarded and auditable. Collection-item rows may cascade only during physical recovery cleanup; posts and post_saves are never cascaded.
DELETE /v1/me/collections/:collectionId.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route. Deletion does not unsave or delete underlying content.

DELETE /v1/me/collections/:collectionId/.purpose: Remove one item membership from an actor-owned collection without unsaving or deleting its source post.
DELETE /v1/me/collections/:collectionId/.authentication: Bearer session with saved:manage capability required.
DELETE /v1/me/collections/:collectionId/.authorization: Both collection ownership and item-to-collection association are enforced.

request.validation: Both UUIDs are schema-validated and cross-associated server-side.

success.body: Envelope data {deleted:true}.

DELETE /v1/me/collections/:collectionId/.idempotencyConcurrency: The item is soft-deleted under a collection lock; a missing/already-removed item returns NOT_FOUND and no source rows are changed.

DELETE /v1/me/drafts/:draftId.purpose: Soft-delete an owned draft and release any unpublished attachment reservations.
DELETE /v1/me/drafts/:draftId.authentication: Bearer session with post:create capability required.
DELETE /v1/me/drafts/:draftId.authorization: Only the authenticated owner may delete; cross-user IDs return NOT_FOUND.

request.validation: Unknown query fields and stale revisions are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data {deleted:true}.

DELETE /v1/me/drafts/:draftId.idempotencyConcurrency: Draft deletion is row-locked and revision-guarded. It never deletes a published post or attachment bytes.
DELETE /v1/me/drafts/:draftId.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route. A draft is never deleted automatically before post publication is confirmed.

GET /v1/communities.purpose: Discover public Communities and list the authenticated viewer's joined Communities with stable server-backed membership state.
GET /v1/communities.authentication: Public route with optional Bearer session. Authentication adds private joined Communities and viewer membership/role fields.
GET /v1/communities.authorization: Anonymous callers see only undeleted public discoverable Communities. Authenticated callers additionally see private Communities only when their membership is active; banned and left memberships never grant access.

query.query: optional name, description or slug search, 1-120 characters

request.validation: Unknown query keys and malformed limits/cursors are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data CursorPage<CommunitySummaryDto> with id, slug, identity, category, visibility, artwork, memberCount, membership, viewerRole, recentActivityAt and version.

pagination.ordering: featured descending, recent activity descending, community ID descending

GET /v1/communities.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only. The cursor contains the complete stable ordering tuple; member counts are derived from active membership rows.
GET /v1/communities.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 additive route. Fields are camelCase and additive response fields may be ignored by older clients. Private Communities are deliberately indistinguishable from absent records without active membership.

GET /v1/communities/:communityId.purpose: Load one Community with authoritative membership, role, policy and member-count state.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId.authentication: Public for public Communities; optional Bearer session supplies viewer state and is required for private Communities.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId.authorization: Private Communities require an active membership. Inaccessible private, deleted and unknown IDs all return NOT_FOUND.

request.validation: Malformed UUIDs are rejected by the route schema.

success.body: Envelope data {community:CommunityDto}.

GET /v1/communities/:communityId.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only; counts are derived from active membership rows at read time.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 additive route. Private Community existence is not disclosed to unauthorized callers.

GET /v1/communities/:communityId/events.purpose: List scheduled and cancelled events for an accessible Community with aggregate and viewer RSVP state.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/events.authentication: Public for public Communities; optional Bearer session supplies viewer response and private access.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/events.authorization: Private Communities require active membership. Deleted events are excluded.

request.validation: Malformed UUID, cursor and limits are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data CursorPage<CommunityEventDto> including location metadata, capacity, status, participant counts and viewerResponse.

GET /v1/communities/:communityId/events.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only; counts are derived from one response row per event and actor.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/events.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 additive route. This contract is RSVP/event discovery only and does not imply ticketing or payment support.

GET /v1/communities/:communityId/events/.purpose: Load one accessible Community event and authoritative RSVP counts/state.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/events/.authentication: Public for public Communities; optional Bearer session is required for private access and viewerResponse.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/events/.authorization: Event must belong to the path Community. Private Communities require active membership; inaccessible IDs return NOT_FOUND.

request.validation: Both UUIDs are schema-validated and cross-associated server-side.

success.body: Envelope data {event:CommunityEventDto}.

GET /v1/communities/:communityId/events/.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only; response counts are transactionally constrained by one response per actor.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/events/.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route. eventId is scoped to communityId to prevent cross-Community object access.

GET /v1/communities/:communityId/members.purpose: List the privacy-filtered active member directory for an accessible Community.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/members.authentication: Public for public Communities; optional Bearer session is required for private Community access and viewer-relative profile privacy.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/members.authorization: Private membership is required for private Communities. Only active memberships are returned; normal profile visibility and block rules still apply.

request.validation: Malformed UUID, cursor and limit values are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data CursorPage<CommunityMemberDto> containing communityId, actorId, role, status, joinedAt and privacy-safe profile.

GET /v1/communities/:communityId/members.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only; cursor ordering remains stable under inserts. Members hidden by profile privacy or blocking are omitted without leaking identity.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/members.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 additive route. actorId is included for stable directory identity; account IDs are never exposed.

GET /v1/communities/:communityId/polls.purpose: List single-choice polls for an accessible Community with results visibility enforced per viewer.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/polls.authentication: Public for public Communities; optional Bearer session is required for private access and viewer vote state.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/polls.authorization: Private Communities require active membership. Deleted polls are excluded; results may be hidden until vote or close according to server policy.

request.validation: Malformed UUID, cursor and limit values are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data CursorPage<CommunityPollDto>; voteCount and totalVotes are null when results are not visible.

GET /v1/communities/:communityId/polls.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only; aggregates are derived from the unique per-actor vote table.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/polls.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 additive route. Initial contract is single-choice only; results suppression uses null rather than fabricated zero counts.

GET /v1/communities/:communityId/polls/:.purpose: Load one Community poll with viewer vote and policy-filtered results.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/polls/:.authentication: Public for public Communities; optional Bearer session is required for private access and viewerOptionId.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/polls/:.authorization: Poll must belong to the path Community. Private access requires active membership and inaccessible IDs return NOT_FOUND.

request.validation: UUIDs and Community association are validated server-side.

success.body: Envelope data {poll:CommunityPollDto}.

GET /v1/communities/:communityId/polls/:.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only; closed is derived from status or closesAt and counts derive from constrained votes.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/polls/:.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route. Hidden aggregate fields are null until results policy allows them.

GET /v1/communities/:communityId/posts.purpose: List canonical social posts associated with a Community without creating a second post store.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/posts.authentication: Public for public Communities; optional Bearer session is required for private Community content and viewer social state.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/posts.authorization: Private Communities require active membership. Hidden, removed and deleted posts are excluded. Existing post/profile block and visibility policy remains authoritative.

request.validation: Malformed UUID, cursor and limits are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data CursorPage<CommunityPostDto>; each item wraps one existing SocialPostDto with communityId, moderationState and featuredAt.

pagination.ordering: featured_at descending nulls last, created_at descending, post ID descending

GET /v1/communities/:communityId/posts.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only. Post identities are the canonical posts.id values used by reactions, comments, saves and shares.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/posts.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 additive route. The embedded SocialPostDto is the established social contract, so native clients do not require a fake Community-only post type.

GET /v1/communities/:communityId/setting.purpose: Load authoritative Community policy plus the authenticated member's persisted notification preferences.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/setting.authorization: Any active, non-restricted member may read settings. Private Community existence is not disclosed without active membership.

request.validation: Malformed UUIDs are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data {settings:{communityId,canManage,membershipPolicy,postingPolicy,inviteLinksEnabled,allowAttachments,reactionsEnabled,featuredPostsEnabled,blockedWords,notificationPreferences:{notifyMentions,weeklyDigest,eventReminders},version,updatedAt}}. blockedWords is null unless canManage is true.

GET /v1/communities/:communityId/setting.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only. Global policy and the caller's notification preferences are read from authoritative server records.
GET /v1/communities/:communityId/setting.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route. inviteLinksEnabled is policy metadata only and does not issue an invite. canManage tells the client whether global mutations are available; sensitive blockedWords are returned only to owners and administrators.

GET /v1/conversations/:id/messages.purpose: List a bounded page of messages for an authenticated member of a direct conversation, including optional minimal Story context for real Story-reply messages.
GET /v1/conversations/:id/messages.authentication: Bearer session required with social:read capability.
GET /v1/conversations/:id/messages.authorization: The authenticated actor must be a non-declined member of the requested direct conversation. Non-members and declined members receive NOT_FOUND without participant disclosure.

query.cursor: optional opaque base64url cursor for the oldest item in the previous page

request.validation: Malformed cursors are rejected. Conversation kind and membership are verified server-side.

success.body: Envelope data {items:[{id,conversationId,sender,body,subject,sentAt,createdAt,isOwn,delivery,storyContext?}],nextCursor:string|null,hasMore:boolean}. storyContext, when present, is {type:'story',storyId,groupId,ownerActorId,mediaKind,createdAt,expiresAt} and intentionally excludes media URLs and captions.

pagination.ordering: created_at descending then message_id descending for selection; items are returned oldest-to-newest within each page

GET /v1/conversations/:id/messages.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only. The optional Story context is joined from the append-only message.story-replied event whose aggregate ID is the message ID; at most one context event exists for an idempotent Story reply.
GET /v1/conversations/:id/messages.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1. Existing message fields and pagination behavior are unchanged. storyContext is optional additive response data; clients that do not render Story context continue to display the ordinary body text.

GET /v1/me/collections.purpose: List the authenticated actor's named Saved collections and authoritative active item counts.
GET /v1/me/collections.authentication: Bearer session with saved:manage capability required.
GET /v1/me/collections.authorization: Collection owner is resolved from the authenticated actor; another actor's collections are never returned.

request.validation: Unknown query fields, malformed cursors and invalid limits are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data CursorPage<SavedCollectionDto>.

GET /v1/me/collections.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only; itemCount is derived from active collection-item rows.
GET /v1/me/collections.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 additive route. This is named organization over existing Saved rows, not a replacement bookmarking system.

GET /v1/me/collections/:collectionId.purpose: Load one authenticated actor-owned named Saved collection.
GET /v1/me/collections/:collectionId.authentication: Bearer session with saved:manage capability required.
GET /v1/me/collections/:collectionId.authorization: Cross-user and deleted collection IDs return NOT_FOUND without ownership disclosure.

request.validation: collectionId is schema-validated.

success.body: Envelope data {collection:SavedCollectionDto}.

GET /v1/me/collections/:collectionId/ite.purpose: List stable ordered items in one actor-owned collection while retaining unavailable source references safely.
GET /v1/me/collections/:collectionId/ite.authentication: Bearer session with saved:manage capability required.
GET /v1/me/collections/:collectionId/ite.authorization: Collection ownership is required. Post hydration applies existing post visibility policy.

request.validation: Malformed UUID, cursor and limit values are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data CursorPage<SavedCollectionItemDto>; unavailable or unsaved sources return available=false and post=null.

GET /v1/me/collections/:collectionId/ite.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only; positions are uniquely constrained among active rows per collection.
GET /v1/me/collections/:collectionId/ite.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route. Unavailable items remain identifiable for explicit removal and can become available after re-save.

GET /v1/me/drafts.purpose: List the authenticated actor's editable post drafts for multi-device reconciliation.
GET /v1/me/drafts.authentication: Bearer session with post:create capability required.
GET /v1/me/drafts.authorization: Only owner_actor_id matching the authenticated actor is queried.

request.validation: Unknown query fields, malformed cursors and invalid limits are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data CursorPage<PostDraftDto>; each draft includes version and updatedAt for reconciliation.

GET /v1/me/drafts.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only; only editing drafts are listed. Published drafts remain addressable by ID for retry confirmation.
GET /v1/me/drafts.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 additive route. Initial server contract is post drafts only; Story and In-Mail drafts remain separate Native gaps.

GET /v1/me/drafts/:draftId.purpose: Load one owned editing or published post draft for synchronization or publish retry recovery.
GET /v1/me/drafts/:draftId.authentication: Bearer session with post:create capability required.
GET /v1/me/drafts/:draftId.authorization: Cross-user and deleted draft IDs return NOT_FOUND.

request.validation: draftId is schema-validated.

success.body: Envelope data {draft:PostDraftDto}, including state, publishedPostId, version and updatedAt.

GET /v1/me/drafts/:draftId.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only. Published state is retained so a lost publish response can be reconciled safely.

GET /v1/me/moliboos/outfit.purpose: Return the authenticated account's persisted equipped Moliboo items and revision.
GET /v1/me/moliboos/outfit.authentication: Bearer session required with social:read capability.
GET /v1/me/moliboos/outfit.authorization: Account ID is resolved from the authenticated session.

request.validation: No request fields.

success.body: Envelope data {revision: integer, updatedAt: ISO timestamp|null, items: OutfitItem[]}.

GET /v1/me/moliboos/outfit.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1; revision is required for optimistic synchronization across devices.

GET /v1/me/moliboos/ownership.purpose: Return the authenticated account's server-authoritative Moliboo ownership inventory.
GET /v1/me/moliboos/ownership.authentication: Bearer session required with social:read capability.
GET /v1/me/moliboos/ownership.authorization: Account ID is resolved from the authenticated session; no client-supplied owner is accepted.

request.validation: Unknown keys and invalid cursors are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data {items: OwnershipItem[], nextCursor: string|null, hasMore: boolean}.

GET /v1/me/moliboos/ownership.idempotencyConcurrency: Safe account-scoped read; duplicate grants are prevented by (accountId,itemId) and grantId uniqueness.
GET /v1/me/moliboos/ownership.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1; additive ownership item fields only.

GET /v1/moliboos/packs.purpose: List the latest cryptographically trusted, approved Moliboo content-pack release for each package.
GET /v1/moliboos/packs.authentication: Public approved-release catalogue; no session required.
GET /v1/moliboos/packs.authorization: Only approved, published or superseded first-party releases with live publisher and signer trust are projected.

request.validation: Unknown query keys and non-approved availability values are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data {items: MolibooPackageDescriptor[], nextCursor: string|null, hasMore: boolean}.

GET /v1/moliboos/packs.idempotencyConcurrency: Safe read. Invalid or concurrently withdrawn releases fail closed and are omitted.
GET /v1/moliboos/packs.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1; descriptor schema modula.package.1; native catalogue schema modula.moliboo.catalog.1; additive descriptor fields only.

GET /v1/moliboos/packs/:packId/download.purpose: Deliver exact immutable bytes for a trusted Moliboo content pack.
GET /v1/moliboos/packs/:packId/download.authentication: Public immutable content; no session required.
GET /v1/moliboos/packs/:packId/download.authorization: Pack selection and trust checks are identical to the manifest endpoint; clients cannot choose storage paths.

request.validation: Unknown fields, malformed IDs and malformed versions are rejected.

success.body: Raw application/vnd.modula.moliboo-asset-pack+json bytes with immutable cache, ETag, content length and X-Modula-Artifact-Sha256 headers.

GET /v1/moliboos/packs/:packId/download.idempotencyConcurrency: Safe immutable read; content address and release identity never change.
GET /v1/moliboos/packs/:packId/download.versioningCompatibility: Content-only JSON container schema modula.moliboo.assetpack.1; maximum 6 MiB artifact, 8 MiB decoded, 16 files, 4 MiB per file; JSON and PNG only.

GET /v1/moliboos/packs/:packId/manifest.purpose: Resolve a trusted install descriptor for a requested Moliboo package and optional immutable version.
GET /v1/moliboos/packs/:packId/manifest.authentication: Public content metadata; no session required.
GET /v1/moliboos/packs/:packId/manifest.authorization: The selected release must be approved and pass live publisher, release-signature, artifact-signature, revocation and quarantine checks.

query.version: optional semantic version; omitted selects newest approved version

request.validation: Unknown fields, malformed IDs and malformed versions are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data {manifest: MolibooPackageDescriptor}.

GET /v1/moliboos/packs/:packId/manifest.idempotencyConcurrency: Safe read. Explicit withdrawn versions fail; an unversioned request falls back to the newest still-approved version.
GET /v1/moliboos/packs/:packId/manifest.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1; descriptor schema modula.package.1; artifact runtimeVersion 1 and minimumHostVersion are enforced by PackageManager.

GET /v1/moliboos/packs/catalog.json.purpose: Return the exact raw catalogue shape consumed by the existing native Moliboo PackageManager.
GET /v1/moliboos/packs/catalog.json.authentication: Public approved-release catalogue; no session required.
GET /v1/moliboos/packs/catalog.json.authorization: Same live release, publisher, signer, revocation and quarantine checks as the paginated catalogue.

request.validation: No request fields.

success.body: Raw {schemaVersion:'modula.moliboo.catalog.1', packages: MolibooPackageDescriptor[]} with Cache-Control: no-cache.

pagination.maximum: Registry bounded to approved Moliboo identities.

GET /v1/moliboos/packs/catalog.json.idempotencyConcurrency: Safe read; every request re-evaluates current trust and withdrawal state.
GET /v1/moliboos/packs/catalog.json.versioningCompatibility: Compatibility endpoint for native PackageManager; catalogue schema is fixed at modula.moliboo.catalog.1.

GET /v1/saves.purpose: List the authenticated actor's existing Saved posts with bounded stable pagination.
GET /v1/saves.authentication: Bearer session with saved:manage capability required.
GET /v1/saves.authorization: Only the authenticated actor's private post_saves rows are queried; inaccessible or deleted source posts are omitted.

request.validation: Unknown query fields, malformed cursors and invalid limits are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data {items:SocialPostDto[],nextCursor:string|null,hasMore:boolean}; the existing items field is preserved for older clients.

pagination.ordering: post_saves.created_at descending then save id descending

GET /v1/saves.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only. Cursor identity is based on immutable save creation time and save ID; saving/unsaving continues through the existing post engagement routes.
GET /v1/saves.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 additive pagination metadata. Existing consumers that read data.items remain compatible.

GET /v1/stickers/packs.purpose: List backward-compatible emoji packs plus approved signed Sprout image packs for composer, message and reaction consumers.
GET /v1/stickers/packs.authentication: Public approved content catalogue; no session required.
GET /v1/stickers/packs.authorization: Database packs are returned only when the signed manifest, publisher, signer, release, revocation/quarantine state and every image digest match.

query.series: optional integer 1-99; filters signed packs and excludes legacy emoji packs

request.validation: Unknown fields, invalid cursors and invalid bounds are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data {packs: StickerPack[], nextCursor: string|null, hasMore: boolean}; signed packs include version, releaseId, package signature/download and per-sticker immutable PNG asset metadata.

GET /v1/stickers/packs.idempotencyConcurrency: Safe read. Invalid or withdrawn database releases are omitted. Comment writes resolve sticker label, emoji and pack server-side and reject unknown IDs.
GET /v1/stickers/packs.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1; existing {id,title,icon,stickers:[{id,emoji,label}]} fields remain; signed package and asset fields are additive.

PATCH /v1/communities/:communityId.purpose: Optimistically update Community identity, discovery and membership/posting policies.
PATCH /v1/communities/:communityId.authorization: Only an active owner or administrator may update the Community. Owner identity and featured status cannot be supplied.

body.name: optional 1-120 characters
body.discoverable: optional boolean, ignored as true when private
body.iconAttachmentId: optional image attachment UUID or null
body.coverAttachmentId: optional image attachment UUID or null

request.validation: At least one change is required. Unknown fields are rejected. New artwork must be owned, ready, unattached image content.

success.body: Envelope data {community:CommunityDto} with incremented version.

PATCH /v1/communities/:communityId.idempotencyConcurrency: UPDATE includes expectedVersion and increments the version atomically; stale writers receive CONFLICT. Membership/posting policy changes serialize with PATCH /settings and also advance the settings revision. Slug uniqueness is database-enforced.
PATCH /v1/communities/:communityId.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route using explicit optimistic concurrency. Changing to private forces discoverable=false without changing immutable Community or owner IDs.

PATCH /v1/communities/:communityId/event.purpose: Optimistically edit or cancel a Community event.
PATCH /v1/communities/:communityId/event.authorization: The event creator or an active owner, administrator or moderator may edit. Event and Community path association is enforced.

request.validation: At least one change is required; unknown fields, invalid time ranges/timezones, non-HTTPS online URLs, invalid cover attachments and capacity below the current Going count are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data {event:CommunityEventDto} with incremented version.

PATCH /v1/communities/:communityId/event.idempotencyConcurrency: UPDATE locks the event and is guarded by expectedVersion. Stale concurrent edits return CONFLICT. Capacity updates serialize with responses and cannot make existing Going state invalid. Cancellation retains the event and existing response history but rejects new response mutations.
PATCH /v1/communities/:communityId/event.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route. Cancellation is a status transition, not destructive deletion.

PATCH /v1/communities/:communityId/polls.purpose: Optimistically cancel a Community poll without deleting votes or audit history.
PATCH /v1/communities/:communityId/polls.authorization: The poll creator or an active owner, administrator or moderator may cancel it.

request.validation: Unknown fields are rejected and poll/Community association is enforced.

success.body: Envelope data {poll:CommunityPollDto} with status=cancelled and incremented version.

PATCH /v1/communities/:communityId/polls.idempotencyConcurrency: UPDATE includes expectedVersion and increments atomically. Stale cancellations receive CONFLICT; vote history is retained.
PATCH /v1/communities/:communityId/polls.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route. Editing poll choices or close times is intentionally not supported after publication.

PATCH /v1/communities/:communityId/setti.purpose: Update member-owned notification preferences and, for authorized operators, optimistic Community policy settings.
PATCH /v1/communities/:communityId/setti.authorization: Active non-restricted members may mutate only their own notifyMentions, weeklyDigest and eventReminders fields. Only active owners and administrators may mutate global settings. Client role and target-user fields are not accepted.

body.expectedVersion: required positive integer when any global setting changes; omitted for notification-only updates
body.membershipPolicy: optional open or approval, owner/admin only
body.postingPolicy: optional members or moderators, owner/admin only
body.inviteLinksEnabled: optional boolean policy flag, owner/admin only
body.blockedWords: optional unique array up to 100 normalized strings, each 1-80 characters, owner/admin only

request.validation: At least one change is required. Unknown fields are rejected. Blocked words are normalized and deduplicated. A member cannot select another actor or submit role fields.

success.body: Envelope data {settings:CommunitySettingsDto}. Global changes increment settings.version; notification-only changes preserve that global version while updating the caller's membership revision.

PATCH /v1/communities/:communityId/setti.idempotencyConcurrency: Global settings UPDATE includes expectedVersion and increments atomically; stale devices receive CONFLICT. Membership/posting policy changes serialize with the Community PATCH contract and advance both Community and settings revisions in the same transaction. Notification patches update only supplied columns on the authenticated membership, so disjoint device writes do not overwrite other fields.
PATCH /v1/communities/:communityId/setti.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route using optimistic concurrency for global policy. Disabling reactions is enforced by the shared post/comment policy engine, including post authors. Invite issuance remains outside this contract.

PATCH /v1/me/collections/:collectionId.purpose: Optimistically rename an authenticated actor-owned Saved collection.
PATCH /v1/me/collections/:collectionId.authentication: Bearer session with saved:manage capability required.
PATCH /v1/me/collections/:collectionId.authorization: Only the owner may rename; owner identity and version are not inferred from client object state.

request.validation: Unknown fields, blank names and duplicate active owner/name pairs are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data {collection:SavedCollectionDto} with incremented version.

PATCH /v1/me/collections/:collectionId.idempotencyConcurrency: UPDATE is guarded by owner and expectedVersion; stale or competing renames return CONFLICT.
PATCH /v1/me/collections/:collectionId.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route with optimistic revision semantics.

PATCH /v1/me/drafts/:draftId.purpose: Optimistically synchronize changes to an owned editable post draft.
PATCH /v1/me/drafts/:draftId.authentication: Bearer session with post:create capability required.
PATCH /v1/me/drafts/:draftId.authorization: Only the authenticated owner may edit; published drafts reject edits.

body.replyPermission: optional everyone, followers, mentioned or none
body.content: optional complete replacement array of up to 10 uploaded attachment references

request.validation: At least one change is required. Unknown fields, stale revisions and invalid/cross-account/unready/reserved attachments are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data {draft:PostDraftDto} with incremented version and updatedAt.

PATCH /v1/me/drafts/:draftId.idempotencyConcurrency: The draft row is locked and expectedVersion must match. Stale two-device edits return CONFLICT; no newer server revision is overwritten silently.
PATCH /v1/me/drafts/:draftId.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route. Clients should surface conflicts for user resolution and reload the latest draft.

POST /v1/admin/qa/moliboos/packs/:packId.purpose: Restore a QA-withdrawn Moliboo release only while its release and signer trust remain valid.
POST /v1/admin/qa/moliboos/packs/:packId.authentication: Bearer session required with admin:ops capability; route is not registered in production.
POST /v1/admin/qa/moliboos/packs/:packId.authorization: QA/development only. Revoked, quarantined, invalidly signed or signer-revoked releases cannot be restored.

body.version: optional semantic version; omitted selects latest

request.validation: Unknown fields and malformed identities are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data {packageId, version, availability:'approved', revision}.

POST /v1/admin/qa/moliboos/packs/:packId.idempotencyConcurrency: Release row is locked. Repeating an already-approved transition returns current state without a duplicate event; restore appends an immutable audit event only on change.
POST /v1/admin/qa/moliboos/packs/:packId.versioningCompatibility: QA-only HTTP v1 operations contract; never present in production runtime.

POST /v1/admin/qa/moliboos/packs/:packId.purpose: Withdraw one approved Moliboo release from QA advertisement while retaining its immutable bytes and prior releases.
POST /v1/admin/qa/moliboos/packs/:packId.authentication: Bearer session required with admin:ops capability; route is not registered in production.
POST /v1/admin/qa/moliboos/packs/:packId.authorization: QA/development only. Release, publisher and signer facts remain immutable; a reason is mandatory.

body.version: optional semantic version; omitted selects latest

request.validation: Unknown fields and malformed identities are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data {packageId, version, availability:'withdrawn', revision}.

POST /v1/admin/qa/moliboos/packs/:packId.idempotencyConcurrency: Release row is locked. Repeating an already-withdrawn transition returns the current revision without a duplicate event; transitions append immutable audit events.
POST /v1/admin/qa/moliboos/packs/:packId.versioningCompatibility: QA-only HTTP v1 operations contract; never present in production runtime.

POST /v1/communities.purpose: Create a persistent Community and atomically establish its settings and authenticated owner membership.
POST /v1/communities.authentication: Bearer session required; owner actor and account are resolved server-side.
POST /v1/communities.authorization: Any authenticated active actor may create a Community while preview mutations are enabled. featured and owner fields are never client-controlled.

body.name: required 1-120 characters
body.slug: optional URL slug, normalized and unique
body.discoverable: optional boolean; forced false for private Communities
body.iconAttachmentId: optional owned ready image attachment UUID
body.coverAttachmentId: optional owned ready image attachment UUID

request.validation: Unknown and privileged fields are rejected before schema sanitization. Artwork must belong to the authenticated account, be ready, unattached and image content.

success.body: Envelope data {community:CommunityDto}; the caller is an active owner and memberCount is 1.

POST /v1/communities.idempotencyConcurrency: Community, settings and owner membership commit in one transaction. A case-insensitive partial unique slug index prevents concurrent duplicate active slugs.
POST /v1/communities.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route. Community IDs are immutable UUIDs. version starts at 1 for optimistic updates. Private discoverability is server-enforced.

POST /v1/communities/:communityId/events.authorization: Active owner, administrator or moderator role required.

body.title: required 1-160 characters
body.timezone: required valid IANA timezone string maximum 100 characters

request.validation: Unknown fields are rejected. Times, IANA timezone, HTTPS online URL, capacity and cover ownership/readiness/type are validated server-side.

success.body: Envelope data {event:CommunityEventDto}; status=scheduled and version=1.

POST /v1/communities/:communityId/events.idempotencyConcurrency: Event, cover binding, audit and domain event commit in one transaction. Event IDs are server-generated UUIDs.
POST /v1/communities/:communityId/events.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route. Location and capacity are bounded metadata; no ticketing, purchasing or attendee identity list is introduced.

POST /v1/communities/:communityId/join.purpose: Join a public Community or submit a pending membership when approval is required.
POST /v1/communities/:communityId/join.authentication: Bearer session required; member actor is resolved server-side.
POST /v1/communities/:communityId/join.authorization: Only public Communities accept self-service joins. Banned memberships are rejected and private IDs return NOT_FOUND. Open Communities activate immediately; approval Communities create pending membership.

request.validation: Client role, status and actor identifiers are not accepted.

success.body: Envelope data {membership:{communityId,role,status,joinedAt,version}}.

POST /v1/communities/:communityId/join.idempotencyConcurrency: A transaction advisory lock plus primary key (community_id,actor_id) serializes retries. Active or pending retries return the same membership without duplicate rows or events.
POST /v1/communities/:communityId/join.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route. Self-service private joining is intentionally absent until an invitation/approval contract is approved.

POST /v1/communities/:communityId/leave.purpose: Persistently leave a Community without deleting Community content or the membership audit history.
POST /v1/communities/:communityId/leave.authorization: The authenticated member may leave their own membership. Owners must transfer ownership first; banned membership state cannot be rewritten by the banned actor.

request.validation: No client actor or role fields are accepted.

success.body: Envelope data {left:true}.

POST /v1/communities/:communityId/leave.idempotencyConcurrency: A transaction advisory lock serializes leave/join for one member. Repeated leave calls are successful no-ops. The row is retained with status=left and incremented version.
POST /v1/communities/:communityId/leave.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route. Leaving never deletes posts, polls, events or the Community.

POST /v1/communities/:communityId/polls.purpose: Create a persistent single-choice Community poll.
POST /v1/communities/:communityId/polls.authorization: Active owner, administrator or moderator role required.

body.question: required 1-500 characters
body.resultsVisibility: optional always, afterVote or afterClose; default afterVote

request.validation: Unknown fields, duplicate normalized options and non-future close times are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data {poll:CommunityPollDto}; status=open and version=1.

POST /v1/communities/:communityId/polls.idempotencyConcurrency: Poll and all options commit in one transaction. Poll, option and position database constraints prevent partial or conflicting option sets.
POST /v1/communities/:communityId/polls.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route. Multi-choice and anonymous voting are not supported by this initial contract.

POST /v1/communities/:communityId/posts.purpose: Create a canonical social post in a Community with server-derived visibility and Community authorization.
POST /v1/communities/:communityId/posts.authentication: Bearer session required with post:create capability.
POST /v1/communities/:communityId/posts.authorization: The actor must have active non-restricted membership. The Community posting policy allows members or restricts to owner/admin/moderator. Audience and Community association are server-derived.

body.text: required unless supported media/content is supplied; maximum 5000 characters

request.validation: Unknown and privileged fields are rejected. Blocked words, attachment ownership/readiness, allowAttachments, membership and posting policy are revalidated inside the post transaction.

success.body: Envelope data {item:CommunityPostDto}. Public Community posts use audience=public; private Community posts use audience=private.

POST /v1/communities/:communityId/posts.idempotencyConcurrency: posts has a unique (author_actor_id,idempotency_key) invariant. Identical concurrent retries return the committed canonical post; a key reused across Community/generic context or with changed text returns CONFLICT. Post, attachments, audit and domain events commit atomically.
POST /v1/communities/:communityId/posts.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route reusing CreatePost and SocialPost contracts. Community packs no new feed identity into normal posts, and Community posts are never AT Protocol cross-posted implicitly.

POST /v1/conversations.purpose: Create or reuse the authenticated sender's one-to-one conversation with an active target account so clients can navigate directly into the thread.
POST /v1/conversations.authentication: Bearer session required with post:engage capability; the sender actor is resolved only from the authenticated session.
POST /v1/conversations.authorization: The target handle must resolve to a live profile on an active account. Self-conversations and either-direction account blocks are rejected. A new recipient becomes active only when they follow the sender; otherwise the conversation is a message request.

body.handle: required target profile handle, string 1-80 characters; an optional leading @ is normalized away
body.text: optional initial message, string maximum 5000 characters; blank non-empty values are rejected

request.validation: Unknown fields, including client-supplied sender or actor identifiers, are rejected. The target is resolved server-side and must remain active. Subsequent messages to a reused conversation use POST /v1/conversations/:id/messages.

success.status: 201 when created; 200 when an existing conversation is reused
success.body: Envelope data {created:boolean, conversation:{id,kind,participants,lastMessage,unreadCount,updatedAt}}. The conversation ID and participant fields are sufficient for native thread navigation.

POST /v1/conversations.idempotencyConcurrency: The sorted authenticated-sender/target actor pair forms the unique direct_key database invariant. Concurrent inserts use INSERT ON CONFLICT and return the same committed conversation. Optional text is creation-only and commits atomically with the conversation and two members, so retry after a lost response cannot duplicate it. A reused conversation returns 200 and does not append text.
POST /v1/conversations.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1. The established handle and optional text request fields remain supported. The created boolean and 200 reuse status are additive; existing clients reading data.conversation remain compatible. Group and In-Mail contracts are unchanged.

POST /v1/me/collections.purpose: Create an authenticated actor-owned named Saved collection.
POST /v1/me/collections.authentication: Bearer session with saved:manage capability required.
POST /v1/me/collections.authorization: Owner identity is server-derived; client owner fields are rejected.

request.validation: Unknown fields and blank names are rejected; active names are case-insensitively unique per owner.

success.body: Envelope data {collection:SavedCollectionDto} with itemCount=0 and version=1.

POST /v1/me/collections.idempotencyConcurrency: A partial unique index on owner and normalized active name prevents concurrent duplicates; state and audit commit together.
POST /v1/me/collections.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route. Collection IDs are immutable UUIDs and version starts at 1.

POST /v1/me/collections/:collectionId/it.purpose: Add an already-Saved post to an actor-owned named collection.
POST /v1/me/collections/:collectionId/it.authentication: Bearer session with saved:manage capability required.
POST /v1/me/collections/:collectionId/it.authorization: The collection and active post_saves row must both belong to the authenticated actor.

body.postId: required UUID of an existing currently Saved post

request.validation: Unknown fields, cross-user collections and posts not present in the caller's active Saved rows are rejected.

success.status: 201 when added; 200 for an existing active membership
success.body: Envelope data {item:SavedCollectionItemDto}.

POST /v1/me/collections/:collectionId/it.idempotencyConcurrency: The collection row serializes position allocation and UNIQUE(collection_id,save_id) prevents duplicate membership. Concurrent identical requests converge on one item ID.
POST /v1/me/collections/:collectionId/it.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route. postId references the canonical existing Saved system.

POST /v1/me/drafts.purpose: Persist a post-composer draft and reserve its uploaded attachment references for the authenticated actor.
POST /v1/me/drafts.authentication: Bearer session with post:create capability required.
POST /v1/me/drafts.authorization: Owner is server-derived. Every attachment must be ready, unattached and owned by the authenticated account.

body.text: required string up to 5000 characters; may be empty when content is present
body.replyPermission: optional everyone, followers, mentioned or none
body.content: optional array of at most 10 typed uploaded attachment references with captions up to 1000 characters
body.publishToAtproto: optional boolean; attachments are not supported when true

request.validation: Unknown/privileged fields, empty text+content, duplicate/cross-account/unready/reserved attachments and legacy base64 media are rejected.

success.status: 201 when created; 200 for an identical idempotent retry
success.body: Envelope data {draft:PostDraftDto} with state=editing and version=1.

POST /v1/me/drafts.idempotencyConcurrency: An optional owner/idempotency-key unique index converges retries; key reuse with a different normalized payload returns CONFLICT. Draft and attachment references commit together.
POST /v1/me/drafts.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route. Uses the canonical CreatePost content/feed/audience/reply contract; clients must upload local media before syncing.

POST /v1/me/drafts/:draftId/publish.purpose: Validate and publish an owned post draft exactly once through the canonical post creation pipeline.
POST /v1/me/drafts/:draftId/publish.owningDomain: Post drafts integrated with canonical posts
POST /v1/me/drafts/:draftId/publish.authentication: Bearer session with post:create capability required.
POST /v1/me/drafts/:draftId/publish.authorization: Draft owner and attachment ownership are resolved server-side; another actor cannot redirect or publish the draft.

request.validation: Unknown fields, stale revisions, invalid composer state and unavailable attachments are rejected before commit.

success.status: 201 for the committing publication; 200 for an already-published or concurrent retry
success.body: Envelope data {draft:PostDraftDto,postId:string,created:boolean}.

POST /v1/me/drafts/:draftId/publish.idempotencyConcurrency: The server derives idempotency key draft-publish:<draftId>. The existing unique post author/key invariant converges concurrent retries, and post creation, attachment activation, outbox/events/audit and draft state/publishedPostId update commit in one database transaction. A stale finalizer rolls back the post; failed publication leaves state=editing.
POST /v1/me/drafts/:draftId/publish.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 new route. The created post is a normal SocialPostDto record consumable without a fake draft post type.

POST /v1/stories/:storyId/replies.purpose: Deliver an authenticated viewer's reply to a concrete live Story item as a persistent message in the Story author's canonical one-to-one conversation.
POST /v1/stories/:storyId/replies.authentication: Bearer session required with post:engage capability; the replying actor is resolved only from the authenticated session.
POST /v1/stories/:storyId/replies.authorization: The Story item must be ready, undeleted and unexpired and must remain visible to the replying actor. The author is resolved from the Story and cannot be redirected by request data. Self replies, either-direction blocks, inactive authors and previously declined recipient message requests are rejected. When no active thread exists, the existing message-request policy determines whether the author's membership is active or pending.

params.storyId: required UUID of a greenfield_story_items item; this is not a Story group ID

body.text: required non-blank reply text, string maximum 5000 characters after trimming
body.idempotencyKey: required client retry key, 8-200 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9, dot, underscore, colon or hyphen

request.validation: Unknown fields, including recipient or author identifiers, are rejected. Invalid or inaccessible Story identifiers return the same NOT_FOUND contract. Story media URLs and captions are not copied into the retained DM context.

success.status: 201 when the reply message is first created; 200 when the same idempotent request is replayed
success.body: Envelope data {conversationId:string, messageId:string, created:boolean, conversationCreated:boolean}. The message is an ordinary direct-message row; a private append-only event provides optional minimal Story context on message reads.

POST /v1/stories/:storyId/replies.idempotencyConcurrency: The server namespaces the supplied key to the authenticated actor, stores a SHA-256 request hash, and serializes identical retries with a transaction-scoped advisory lock. Story authorization, canonical conversation creation/reuse, message insertion, private context event, idempotent notification outbox job and stored response commit in one PostgreSQL transaction. Identical retries return the original IDs without another message or event; reuse with different Story text or ID returns CONFLICT. The sorted actor pair retains the direct_key uniqueness invariant.
POST /v1/stories/:storyId/replies.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 additive route. storyId means the concrete Story item ID already exposed as StoryItem.itemId. The DM body remains a normal message consumable by existing conversation clients. Optional storyContext fields on message reads are additive and may be ignored by older clients. Deleted or expired Stories cannot receive new replies, while an already-created DM and its non-media context remain readable under normal conversation retention.

PUT /v1/communities/:communityId/events/.purpose: Set or clear the authenticated member's Going or Interested state for a Community event.
PUT /v1/communities/:communityId/events/.authorization: Active non-restricted Community membership required. Cancelled events reject response changes.

body.response: required going, interested or null to remove

request.validation: Unknown fields and invalid response values are rejected. Event/Community association and capacity are server-validated.

success.body: Envelope data {event:CommunityEventDto} with updated counts and viewerResponse.

PUT /v1/communities/:communityId/events/.idempotencyConcurrency: Primary key (event_id,actor_id) permits one response per actor. A transaction advisory lock serializes capacity checks; identical retries are no-ops and concurrent final Going slots cannot exceed capacity.
PUT /v1/communities/:communityId/events/.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 PUT replacement semantics. null removes the response without deleting the event or membership.

PUT /v1/communities/:communityId/polls/:.purpose: Set the authenticated member's single choice in an open Community poll.
PUT /v1/communities/:communityId/polls/:.authorization: Active non-restricted Community membership required. The option must belong to the path poll and Community.

request.validation: Unknown fields, closed/cancelled polls and options from another poll are rejected. allowVoteChanges is server-enforced.

success.body: Envelope data {poll:CommunityPollDto} with viewerOptionId and visible results according to policy.

PUT /v1/communities/:communityId/polls/:.idempotencyConcurrency: Primary key (poll_id,actor_id) and composite option foreign key enforce one valid choice. A per-poll/actor advisory lock serializes retries and changes; the same option is an idempotent no-op.
PUT /v1/communities/:communityId/polls/:.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 PUT replacement semantics. Vote changes are supported only when allowVoteChanges=true; aggregate results remain server-derived.

PUT /v1/me/moliboos/outfit.purpose: Atomically replace the authenticated account's equipped Moliboo items after ownership and wearability checks.
PUT /v1/me/moliboos/outfit.authentication: Bearer session required with profile:customize capability.
PUT /v1/me/moliboos/outfit.authorization: Every item must belong to the authenticated account, match its server-owned slot, remain wearable and not be revoked; Legends 101-115 are non-wearable.

body.items: required array, maximum 16, unique slot and itemId; each {slot,itemId}

request.validation: Unknown privileged fields, invalid slots, duplicates, unowned items and revoked/non-wearable items are rejected.

success.body: Envelope data {revision, updatedAt, items}; ownership and equipped state commit in one transaction.

PUT /v1/me/moliboos/outfit.idempotencyConcurrency: Outfit row is locked in a transaction. expectedRevision makes competing writes deterministic: one succeeds and stale writes return REVISION_CONFLICT without partial state.
PUT /v1/me/moliboos/outfit.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1; clients should persist the returned revision and send it on subsequent writes.
